title: Optimal Transport for Machine Learners
tldr_zh: 面向 ML 的 OT 全景教材，16 章从点云匹配到 flow matching/transformer，本课题首推入门书
tldr_en: 480-page ML-oriented OT textbook: Monge/Kantorovich, Brenier, Sinkhorn, gradient flows, flow matching and transformers, with POT-based code.
key_numbers: 16 chapters, 480 pages (v3, Aug 2026; TOC pp. iii-v)
Thm 2.23 Brenier: unique optimal map = gradient of convex potential under absolute continuity of source (Sec. 2.4)
Prop. 2.30: displacement interpolation is a constant-speed geodesic, W_p(alpha_s,alpha_t)=(t-s)W_p(alpha,beta) (Sec. 2.4)
Prop. 2.31 Caffarelli: C^alpha densities on uniformly convex domains give C^{2,alpha}_loc potential (Sec. 2.4)
